nodes.name: Electrochemical dealloying of NiWIr-ED
nodes.procedure: The electrodeposited NiWIr-ED was subjected to electrochemical de-alloying using the chrono potentiometric method over a span of 2 h, with a solution consisting of 0.5 M H2SO4. Following the de-alloying process, the resulting material was repeatedly washed with deionized (DI) water and subsequently subjected to vacuum drying. During the initial 35 min, potential remains at approximately 0.2 V RHE (dissolution of exposed nickel), then sudden increase to 1.47 V RHE for complete oxidation over following 80 min.

unit_operations.name: Oxidation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: The potential experiences a sudden increase to around 1.47 V RHE, ensuring complete oxidation over the following 80 min

nodes.source_text: The electrodeposited NiWIr-ED was subjected to electrochemical de-alloying, resulting in the production of highly nanoporous NiWlrO_x as illustrated in Fig. 1a. This process was carried out using the chrono potentiometric method and took place over a span of 2 h, with a solution consisting of 0.5 M H2SO4.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiWIrOx shows nanoporous structure with catalyst layer thickness of ~2 μm and nanoparticle morphology after dealloying.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The cross-sectional SEM images shows that the thickness of the catalyst layer is approximately 2 μm for both NiWIr-ED and NiWIrOx samples...

nodes.characterization_summary: NiWIrOx nanoparticles 1.5-3 nm show (200) plane of IrO2 with lattice spacing 0.225 nm; NiWIr-ED shows polycrystalline structure with (111) planes at 0.215 nm and 0.209 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HRTEM of NiWIrOx nanoparticle sizes are 1.5 to 3 nm... corresponding to a lattice fringe with a spacing of 0.225 nm (Fig. 2h).

nodes.characterization_summary: NiWIrOx shows nanocrystalline structure with only Ir(200) crystalline planes visible in FFT; uniform W distribution confirmed by EDS mapping.
nodes.evidence_snippet: HAADF-STEM images depicted in Fig. 2m, n corroborate that the aggregated particle structures of NiWIrOx consist of nanocrystals.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiWIr-ED shows alloy peaks at 44.271°(111) and 51.541°(200); NiWIrOx shows nanobroadening due to 1.5-3 nm particles making phase identification challenging.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the X-ray Powder Diffraction (XRD) patterns... the peaks associated with NiWIr-ED at 44.271 (111) and 51.541 (200) exhibit a slight deviation...

nodes.characterization_summary: NiWIrOx shows Eg/B2g peaks at 549/721 cm⁻¹ (shifted higher from NiIrOx at 546/719 cm⁻¹) indicating W substitution at Ir octahedral sites.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The distinctive Raman peaks (546/719 cm⁻¹ Eg/B2g) in NiIrOx resemble those found in NiWIrOx, yet they exhibit a shift towards higher frequencies...

nodes.characterization_summary: NiWIrOx composition: W 8.7 at% (ICP: 8.8 at%); NiWIr-ED: Ni54 W0.1 Ir2.89; lower Ni content in NiWIrOx vs precursor.
nodes.evidence_snippet: This is substantiated by the findings obtained from EDS and inductively coupled plasma (ICP) emission spectroscopy, which collectively affirm the incorporation of W...

nodes.characterization_summary: NiWIrOx shows W 8.8 at% incorporation and Ir dissolution rate of 0.01 mg L⁻¹ h⁻¹ (vs 0.16 mg L⁻¹ h⁻¹ for NiIrOx) after 312 h OER.
nodes.evidence_snippet: ICP-OES revealed that the dissolution of Ir... decreased from 0.16 mg L⁻¹·h⁻¹ on NiIrOx to 0.01 mg L⁻¹·h⁻¹ on NiWIrOx...

nodes.characterization_summary: NiWIrOx shows Ir⁰, Ir³⁺, Ir⁴⁺ with negative Ir4f shift and positive W4f shift indicating W→O→Ir electron transfer; optimal 91% OH/(O+OH) surface concentration.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A deconvolution analysis is performed on the Ir 4f spectra, revealing the presence of Ir0, Ir3+, and Ir4+ species... negative shift as W-O were incorporated...

nodes.characterization_summary: NiWIrOx Ir L3-edge shows reduced white-line intensity vs NiIrOx indicating lower Ir oxidation state; Ir-O 1.97 Å (vs 1.98 Å NiIrOx); Rd=0.825 indicating high Ir-O covalency.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The fitted EXAFS parameters... reveal a first Ir-O shell distance of 1.98 Å and 1.97 Å within the [IrO6] octahedron for NiIrOx and NiWIrOx...

nodes.characterization_summary: NiWIrOx Cdl=657 mF·cm⁻² (Rf=10950 dimensionless); NiIrOx Cdl=464 mF·cm⁻² (Rf=7733 dimensionless) confirming high ECSA from nanoporosity.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Cdl values for NiWIrOx, NiIrOx, IrOx-Com, Ir-ED and IrW-ED are as follows: 657, 464, 167, 9.5, and 1.5 mF·cm⁻², respectively.
